Description: Controls the sky display and the generated environment lighting maps.

SkyReady.title: Sky Ready
SkyReady.description: Whether the sky map and generated lighting maps are currently ready.

Params.Name: RenderSky
Params.Label: Render Sky
Params.Description: Render the loaded skybox in the viewport background.

Params.Name: SkyMapPath
Params.Description: Path of the equirectangular HDR or LDR sky map used to generate the environment maps.

Params.Name: SkyboxSize
Params.Label: Environment Map Size
Params.Description: Resolution of the generated environment cube. Use a power-of-two value; larger values increase sky-map generation cost and memory use.

Params.Name: IrradianceMapSize
Params.Label: Irradiance Map Size
Params.Description: Resolution of the generated diffuse irradiance cube. Use a power-of-two value.

Buttons.Label: Load Sky Texture
Buttons.Description: Choose an HDR or LDR equirectangular sky map and rebuild the generated environment maps.

Buttons.Label: Reload Shaders
Buttons.Description: Reload the skybox and environment-map compute shaders.
